segments.en: Hello.
Where are you from?
I am from Trivandrum. Where are you?
This is Kollam.
Okay, what do you do?
I used to work at a factory, but I don't do anything now.
Okay, you are awake, right? You don't have sleep at night?
In the morning, now... this, I was... sorry, I was awake last night.
Is that so?
Why, what's the matter? Why didn't you sleep?
I need some money in the morning.
Is that so?
Yes.
Is there any...
Yes, there is. There is an open door, it's on WhatsApp, it's a paid service.
Why is it like that?
We get 5 rupees from this per minute. So, we don't have to do anything for free.
You are getting it, right?
If you are getting it in this, it's your choice.
I just said it, if I do it, I only do it on WhatsApp. For me, it's a safety issue because it's risky.
Okay.
Bye bye, look for something else.
